PLEASE PRAY!

I’m headed to Manilla later today (will land after 19 hours of flying, not counting layovers.) The @Dare2Share mobilization team is already there.

We will be conspiring with 200 global youth leaders on how to see every teen everywhere hear the gospel from a friend, training several hundred church volunteers to share the Gospel and then I’ll be preaching at the largest church in the Philippines, Christ Commission Fellowship (Thanks for the invite @ErickTotanes!) 

This amazing church, led by Pastor Peter Tan-Chi, is on fire for Christ and believes in the power of the Gospel and the potential of youth. 

Pray for the following over the next 8 days of traveling and ministry:

✔️ many gospel conversations to take place along the way

✔️ great favor for the advancement of the Gospel through these 200 global leaders and the youth they represent 

✔️ a deepening of the relationship and co-ownership of the vision (every teen everywhere) with this amazing church

✔️ favor for my family as I’m gone

✔️ health for me and our team on the road.

Thanks for your prayers! They make a difference!

“On him we have set our hope that he will continue to deliver us, as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the gracious favor granted us in answer to the prayers of many.” 2 Corinthians 1:10,11

Nakipagpulong si Mayor Joy Belmonte sa Cristina Research Foundation Inc., sa pangunguna ni Dr. Victor S. Limlingan, ngayong Lunes.

Layon ng meeting na tugunan ang lumalalang congestion sa mga pampublikong paaralan. Tinitingnan ang iba-ibang solusyon, para masiguro ang komportable at maayos na learning environment para sa mga mag-aaral.

Nasa pulong din sina Schools Division Office Superintendent Carleen Sedilla, Education Affairs Unit Chief Maricris Veloso, Youth Development Office Head Lyn Dividina, at City Planing and Development Department Head Jed Gomez.

data.raw_text:
ICYMI: Habagat season is here again, and once more Metro Manila is drowning in floods. Beloved PGMN Anchor Orion Perez — AKA the Angry Bowtie — breaks down why this problem has been haunting us for centuries: from the warnings of the Spanish era, to the neglected plans of Burnham and Palafox, to the clogged esteros and floodplains we still ignore today.

Why does Singapore, a country once filled with swamplands, no longer suffer from the same flooding we do? And why has Metro Manila remained hostage to poor systems, disjointed governance, and short-term politics? Orion connects the dots between history, bad policy, and our failure to act on long-term solutions.

https://t.co/ciBF0zFx15
